seeds.title: Split source, requested, and effective states
seeds.statement: UI and data models should keep `source`, `requested`, and `effective` as separate concepts across settings, runtime, and history surfaces.
evidence: Candidate fixes call for separating source, requested, and effective in UI language and models.
Contradictions note users currently confuse current settings winner, requested run state, and effective runtime result.

seeds.title: Freeze historical requested/effective state
seeds.statement: Historical run views must render the frozen requested/effective state from that run and must not recompute from current settings or inheritance.
evidence: Historical-run implication requires showing frozen requested/effective state from that run.
Do-not-forget details repeat that historical run views must stay frozen.

seeds.title: Extend override grammar to worker policy
seeds.statement: The same override display grammar used for provider/model/persona/account should be extended to worker policy, including source, requested, effective, and reason fields.
evidence: Worker-policy implication lists source, requested (`subagent`, `fresh_worker`), effective, and reason.
Candidate fixes explicitly say to extend the same model to worker policy.

seeds.title: Keep one global persona precedence chain
seeds.statement: Auto Persona resolution should keep one global precedence chain while requiring deterministic, surface-specific resolver outputs with ranked candidates and explanation metadata.
evidence: Recommended resolver shape says keep one global precedence chain.
The same section requires each surface auto resolver to emit deterministic ranked candidates plus explanation metadata.

seeds.title: Prioritize actor and operation signals
seeds.statement: Inside auto resolution, actor type and operation type should dominate stack or repository hints to avoid role-inappropriate persona selection.
evidence: Deterministic input priority lists actor-type and operation-type bias before language/framework hints.
Explicit examples say reviewer passes and seam overseers should not collapse into coding personas from repo traits alone.

seeds.title: Define explicit orchestrator actor mappings
seeds.statement: Orchestrator auto mode should map each actor role to an explicit default persona family, even if exact persona IDs remain evolvable.
evidence: Orchestrator-specific direction maps package/seam overseers, node workers, reviewers, corroborators, recovery actors, and graph patch planners.
The document states mapping policy should be explicit now even if IDs can evolve.

seeds.title: Use deterministic fallback, not hard block
seeds.statement: If a preferred persona is unavailable after capability filtering, resolution should deterministically fall through to the next candidate and record requested/effective outcomes with reason metadata.
evidence: Fallback direction says do not block solely because a preferred Persona is unavailable.
Fallback direction requires recording requested Persona, effective Persona, selection reason, and skipped controls.

seeds.title: Retain clarification when tie remains
seeds.statement: When same-tier candidates remain non-deterministic, the system should ask for clarification rather than speculating, with this expected to be rare in Orchestrator due to actor+operation signals.
evidence: Clarification rule keeps the Prompt Pipeline behavior of asking when deterministic choice is not possible.
Orchestrator note says ambiguity should usually be resolved by actor type plus operation type.

seeds.title: Provide concise reason with expandable detail
seeds.statement: Auto selection output should include one short primary reason for compact UI and optional expanded supporting hints, without exposing noisy full candidate scoring by default.
evidence: Explanation direction recommends concise structured reason text and provides compact examples.
Recommendation says one short primary reason plus optional expanded explanation, and not a noisy scored-all-candidates default.

seeds.title: Clarify account policy versus effective account
seeds.statement: Runtime surfaces should separately display account policy, effective account, and switch reason to prevent confusion between manual preference, project policy snapshots, and live selection.
evidence: Multi-account implication distinguishes requested account policy, manual preferred account, and effective account.
Recommended display shows separate fields for account policy, effective account, and switch reason.
